summary: ClimateRock, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting an October 19, 2026 amendment to its amended and restated merger agreement with GreenRock Corp. The amendment removes the TEP Renewables Limited acquisition as a closing condition, eliminates the earnout escrow, and extends the Outside Date from May 2, 2025 to March 31, 2027. The transaction is structured as a SPAC business combination with Cayman merger subs and a Holdings F-4 proxy/prospectus. No price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. Watch for definitive proxy timing, redemption levels, and whether the simplified conditions accelerate closing.
